title_en: Reporting with passives; It is said that …
title_vi: Tường thuật bằng câu bị động; It is said that …
theory_html:
A. Passive reporting

A. Tường thuật bằng bị động

We often use a passive to report what people say, think, etc., particularly if it is not important to mention who is being reported:

Ta thường dùng bị động để tường thuật điều người ta nói, nghĩ v.v., nhất là khi không quan trọng việc ai được tường thuật:

  • People in the area have been told that they should stay indoors.

    Người dân trong khu vực đã được thông báo nên ở trong nhà.

  • Everyone was asked to bring some food to the party.

    Mọi người được yêu cầu mang đồ ăn đến bữa tiệc.

B. it + passive verb + that-clause

B. it + động từ bị động + mệnh đề that

Another common way of reporting what is said by an unspecified group of people is to use it + passive verb + that-clause. Using this pattern allows us to put important information at the end of the sentence:

Một cách phổ biến khác để tường thuật điều một nhóm người không xác định nói là dùng it + động từ bị động + mệnh đề that. Cấu trúc này cho phép đặt thông tin quan trọng ở cuối câu:

  • It is reported that the damage is extensive. (compare The damage is extensive, according to government sources.)

    Có tin cho biết thiệt hại rất lớn.

  • It was decided that the meeting should be cancelled. (or It was decided to cancel the meeting.)

    Người ta đã quyết định hủy cuộc họp.

Also: allege, announce, assume, believe, calculate, claim, consider, demonstrate, discover, establish, estimate, expect, feel, find, know, mention, recommend, reveal, say, show, suggest, suppose, think, understand; agree, decide, hope, intend, plan, propose (can also be followed by a to-infinitive clause)

Tương tự: allege, announce, assume, believe, calculate, claim, consider, demonstrate, discover, establish, estimate, expect, feel, find, know, mention, recommend, reveal, say, show, suggest, suppose, think, understand; agree, decide, hope, intend, plan, propose (cũng có thể đi với mệnh đề to-V)

Note that many other verbs connected with reporting are not used with it + passive verb + that-clause, but can be used as in A:

Lưu ý: nhiều động từ tường thuật khác không dùng với it + bị động + mệnh đề that, nhưng có thể dùng như ở A:

  • We have been informed that we have to leave. (but not It has informed us …)

    Chúng tôi đã được thông báo là phải rời đi.

Also: encourage, persuade, reassure, remind, tell, warn. These verbs need a personal object before the that-clause in an active form (e.g. They have informed us that …)

Tương tự: encourage, persuade, reassure, remind, tell, warn. Các động từ này cần tân ngữ chỉ người trước mệnh đề that ở dạng chủ động (vd They have informed us that …)

C. subject + passive verb + to-infinitive

C. chủ ngữ + động từ bị động + to-V

An alternative to it + passive verb + that-clause is to use subject + passive verb + to-infinitive if we want the subject to be the topic of the sentence. Compare:

Một cách thay cho it + bị động + mệnh đề that là dùng chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V khi muốn chủ ngữ là chủ đề của câu. So sánh:

  • It is reported that the damage is extensive. → The damage is reported to be extensive.

    Có tin cho biết thiệt hại rất lớn. → Thiệt hại được cho là rất lớn.

Most of the verbs listed in B can also be used in this pattern except for announce, decide, mention, propose, recommend, suggest.

Phần lớn động từ liệt kê ở B cũng dùng được trong cấu trúc này, trừ announce, decide, mention, propose, recommend, suggest.

We can only use tell in this pattern when it means ‘order’:

Chỉ dùng tell trong cấu trúc này khi nó mang nghĩa ‘ra lệnh’:

  • I was told (= ordered) to go with them to the railway station. (but not ‘The accident was told (= said) to have happened just after midnight’.)

    Tôi được lệnh đi cùng họ đến nhà ga.

D. it + passive verb + wh-clause

D. it + động từ bị động + mệnh đề wh-

With some verbs we can also use it + passive verb + wh-clause to report information given or found out:

Với một số động từ, có thể dùng it + bị động + mệnh đề wh- để tường thuật thông tin được đưa ra hoặc phát hiện:

  • It has now been revealed who was responsible for the accident.

    Giờ đã lộ ra ai chịu trách nhiệm cho vụ tai nạn.

  • The decision to build the bridge was taken before it was established whether it was actually needed.

    Quyết định xây cầu được đưa ra trước khi xác định được liệu nó có thực sự cần không.

Also: discover, explain, find, know, reveal, show, understand

Tương tự: discover, explain, find, know, reveal, show, understand

E. there + passive verb + to be / to have been

E. there + động từ bị động + to be / to have been

When a that-clause begins that + there …, we can make a corresponding passive form there + passive verb + to be / to have been. Compare:

Khi mệnh đề that bắt đầu bằng that + there …, có thể tạo dạng bị động tương ứng there + bị động + to be / to have been. So sánh:

  • It is thought (that) there are too many obstacles to peace. → There are thought to be too many obstacles to peace.

    Người ta cho rằng có quá nhiều trở ngại cho hòa bình.

We can use the same verbs in this pattern as with subject + passive verb + to-infinitive.

Có thể dùng cùng các động từ như ở cấu trúc chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V.

mcq.question: People in the area ___ that they should stay indoors.
mcq.full: People in the area have been told that they should stay indoors.
mcq.vi: Người dân trong khu vực đã được thông báo nên ở trong nhà.
mcq.expl:
Use passives (be told / be asked / be informed) to report what people say when the reporter is not important.
Dùng bị động (be told / be asked / be informed) để tường thuật khi người nói không quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Tường thuật bằng bị động.
mcq.key: People in the area ___ that they should stay indoors.|have been told

mcq.question: Everyone ___ to bring some food to the party.
mcq.full: Everyone was asked to bring some food to the party.
mcq.vi: Mọi người được yêu cầu mang đồ ăn đến bữa tiệc.
mcq.expl:
Use passives (be told / be asked / be informed) to report what people say when the reporter is not important.
Dùng bị động (be told / be asked / be informed) để tường thuật khi người nói không quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be asked + to-V.
mcq.key: Everyone ___ to bring some food to the party.|was asked

mcq.question: ___ that the damage is extensive.
mcq.full: It is reported that the damage is extensive.
mcq.vi: Có tin cho biết thiệt hại rất lớn.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + bị động + that.
mcq.key: ___ that the damage is extensive.|It is reported

mcq.question: It ___ that the meeting should be cancelled.
mcq.full: It was decided that the meeting should be cancelled.
mcq.vi: Người ta đã quyết định hủy cuộc họp.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + bị động + that.
mcq.key: It ___ that the meeting should be cancelled.|was decided

mcq.question: We ___ that we have to leave.
mcq.full: We have been informed that we have to leave.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đã được thông báo là phải rời đi.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: inform không dùng It + bị động; dùng chủ ngữ người + be informed.
mcq.key: We ___ that we have to leave.|have been informed

mcq.question: It was ___ to hold new negotiations next month.
mcq.full: It was agreed to hold new negotiations next month.
mcq.vi: Người ta đã đồng ý tổ chức vòng đàm phán mới vào tháng sau.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + to-V (announce không đi với to-V).
mcq.key: It was ___ to hold new negotiations next month.|agreed

mcq.question: It has been ___ that the crash was the result of pilot error.
mcq.full: It has been shown that the crash was the result of pilot error.
mcq.vi: Người ta đã chứng minh rằng vụ tai nạn do lỗi phi công.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It has been shown that (proposed cũng được).
mcq.key: It has been ___ that the crash was the result of pilot error.|shown

mcq.question: It has been ___ to appoint Dr Ahmadi as head teacher.
mcq.full: It has been decided to appoint Dr Ahmadi as head teacher.
mcq.vi: Người ta đã quyết định bổ nhiệm Tiến sĩ Ahmadi làm hiệu trưởng.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: decide + to-V (suggest không đi với to-V).
mcq.key: It has been ___ to appoint Dr Ahmadi as head teacher.|decided

mcq.question: It is ___ to employ 500 people in the factory.
mcq.full: It is intended to employ 500 people in the factory.
mcq.vi: Người ta dự định tuyển 500 người vào nhà máy.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: intend + to-V.
mcq.key: It is ___ to employ 500 people in the factory.|intended

mcq.question: It is ___ to close the library permanently from next April.
mcq.full: It is planned to close the library permanently from next April.
mcq.vi: Người ta có kế hoạch đóng cửa thư viện vĩnh viễn từ tháng Tư tới.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: plan + to-V (recommend không đi với to-V ở đây).
mcq.key: It is ___ to close the library permanently from next April.|planned

mcq.question: It is ___ that another moon landing will take place next year.
mcq.full: It is thought that another moon landing will take place next year.
mcq.vi: Người ta cho rằng sẽ có thêm một cuộc đổ bộ mặt trăng vào năm sau.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It is thought that (assumed cũng được).
mcq.key: It is ___ that another moon landing will take place next year.|thought

mcq.question: It was ___ that Mrs Ho would chair the meeting.
mcq.full: It was hoped that Mrs Ho would chair the meeting.
mcq.vi: Người ta hy vọng bà Ho sẽ chủ trì cuộc họp.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It was hoped that (explained cũng được).
mcq.key: It was ___ that Mrs Ho would chair the meeting.|hoped

mcq.question: WATER DISCOVERED ON MARS → It ___ that there is water on Mars.
mcq.full: WATER DISCOVERED ON MARS → It has been discovered that there is water on Mars.
mcq.vi: PHÁT HIỆN NƯỚC TRÊN SAO HỎA → Người ta đã phát hiện có nước trên sao Hỏa.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + bị động + that.
mcq.key: WATER DISCOVERED ON MARS → It ___ that there is water on Mars.|has been discovered

mcq.question: TERRORISTS BELIEVED TO BE OPERATING IN BERLIN → It ___ that terrorists are operating in Berlin.
mcq.full: TERRORISTS BELIEVED TO BE OPERATING IN BERLIN → It is believed that terrorists are operating in Berlin.
mcq.vi: NGHI CÓ KHỦNG BỐ HOẠT ĐỘNG Ở BERLIN → Người ta tin khủng bố đang hoạt động ở Berlin.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It is believed that.
mcq.key: TERRORISTS BELIEVED TO BE OPERATING IN BERLIN → It ___ that terrorists are operating in Berlin.|is believed

mcq.question: MOON ASTRONAUTS EXPECTED TO RETURN TODAY → It ___ that the moon astronauts will return today.
mcq.full: MOON ASTRONAUTS EXPECTED TO RETURN TODAY → It is expected that the moon astronauts will return today.
mcq.vi: PHI HÀNH GIA MẶT TRĂNG DỰ KIẾN TRỞ VỀ HÔM NAY → Dự kiến các phi hành gia sẽ trở về hôm nay.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It is expected that.
mcq.key: MOON ASTRONAUTS EXPECTED TO RETURN TODAY → It ___ that the moon astronauts will return today.|is expected

mcq.question: KING SAID TO BE MAKING GOOD RECOVERY → It ___ that the King is making a good recovery.
mcq.full: KING SAID TO BE MAKING GOOD RECOVERY → It is said that the King is making a good recovery.
mcq.vi: NHÀ VUA ĐƯỢC CHO LÀ ĐANG HỒI PHỤC TỐT → Người ta nói nhà vua đang hồi phục tốt.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: It is said that.
mcq.key: KING SAID TO BE MAKING GOOD RECOVERY → It ___ that the King is making a good recovery.|is said

mcq.question: PATIENTS REASSURED ABOUT HOSPITAL SAFETY → ___
mcq.a: Patients have been reassured about hospital safety.
mcq.b: It has been reassured that hospital is safe.
mcq.c: It has reassured patients that hospital is safe.
mcq.full: PATIENTS REASSURED ABOUT HOSPITAL SAFETY → Patients have been reassured about hospital safety.
mcq.vi: BỆNH NHÂN ĐƯỢC TRẤN AN VỀ AN TOÀN BỆNH VIỆN → Bệnh nhân đã được trấn an về an toàn bệnh viện.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + that-clause; not with inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (they need a personal object).
It + bị động (is reported / was decided / is thought …) + mệnh đề that; không dùng với inform / tell / warn / reassure / remind / persuade (cần tân ngữ chỉ người).
Điểm ngữ pháp: reassure không dùng It + bị động + that.
mcq.key: PATIENTS REASSURED ABOUT HOSPITAL SAFETY → ___|Patients have been reassured about hospital safety.

mcq.question: It is reported that the damage is extensive. → The damage is reported ___ extensive.
mcq.full: It is reported that the damage is extensive. → The damage is reported to be extensive.
mcq.vi: Có tin cho biết thiệt hại rất lớn. → Thiệt hại được cho là rất lớn.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V.
mcq.key: It is reported that the damage is extensive. → The damage is reported ___ extensive.|to be

mcq.question: I was told ___ with them to the railway station. (= ordered)
mcq.full: I was told to go with them to the railway station. (= ordered)
mcq.vi: Tôi được lệnh đi cùng họ đến nhà ga.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell (= ra lệnh) + to-V.
mcq.key: I was told ___ with them to the railway station. (= ordered)|to go

mcq.question: We have discovered that a mechanical fault caused the problem. → A mechanical fault was discovered ___ the problem.
mcq.full: We have discovered that a mechanical fault caused the problem. → A mechanical fault was discovered to have caused the problem.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi phát hiện lỗi cơ khí gây ra sự cố. → Lỗi cơ khí được phát hiện là đã gây ra sự cố.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Sự việc trước → to have + V3.
mcq.key: We have discovered that a mechanical fault caused the problem. → A mechanical fault was discovered ___ the problem.|to have caused

mcq.question: We don’t think that the fault is serious. → The fault is not thought ___ serious.
mcq.full: We don’t think that the fault is serious. → The fault is not thought to be serious.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi không nghĩ lỗi này nghiêm trọng. → Lỗi này được cho là không nghiêm trọng.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be thought + to be.
mcq.key: We don’t think that the fault is serious. → The fault is not thought ___ serious.|to be

mcq.question: We expect that it will take several weeks to correct the fault. → The fault is expected ___ several weeks to correct.
mcq.full: We expect that it will take several weeks to correct the fault. → The fault is expected to take several weeks to correct.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi dự kiến mất vài tuần để sửa lỗi. → Lỗi này dự kiến mất vài tuần để sửa.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: be expected + to-V.
mcq.key: We expect that it will take several weeks to correct the fault. → The fault is expected ___ several weeks to correct.|to take

mcq.question: We have decided to postpone the next rocket launch. → It ___ to postpone the next rocket launch.
mcq.full: We have decided to postpone the next rocket launch. → It has been decided to postpone the next rocket launch.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đã quyết định hoãn lần phóng tên lửa tới. → Đã có quyết định hoãn lần phóng tên lửa tới.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: decide chỉ dùng It + bị động (không dùng chủ ngữ + be decided to).
mcq.key: We have decided to postpone the next rocket launch. → It ___ to postpone the next rocket launch.|has been decided

mcq.question: We suggest that the next launch should take place in May. → It ___ that the next launch should take place in May.
mcq.full: We suggest that the next launch should take place in May. → It is suggested that the next launch should take place in May.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đề nghị lần phóng tới diễn ra vào tháng Năm. → Có đề nghị lần phóng tới diễn ra vào tháng Năm.
mcq.expl:
Subject + passive + to-infinitive (The damage is reported to be …); not with announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell only = order.
Chủ ngữ + bị động + to-V (The damage is reported to be …); không dùng với announce / decide / mention / propose / recommend / suggest; tell chỉ khi = ra lệnh.
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest chỉ dùng It + bị động + that.
mcq.key: We suggest that the next launch should take place in May. → It ___ that the next launch should take place in May.|is suggested

mcq.question: It has now been ___ who was responsible for the accident.
mcq.full: It has now been revealed who was responsible for the accident.
mcq.vi: Giờ đã lộ ra ai chịu trách nhiệm cho vụ tai nạn.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + wh-clause.
It + bị động (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + mệnh đề wh-.
Điểm ngữ pháp: It + bị động + mệnh đề wh-.
mcq.key: It has now been ___ who was responsible for the accident.|revealed

mcq.question: The decision to build the bridge was taken before it was ___ whether it was actually needed.
mcq.full: The decision to build the bridge was taken before it was established whether it was actually needed.
mcq.vi: Quyết định xây cầu được đưa ra trước khi xác định được liệu nó có thực sự cần không.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + wh-clause.
It + bị động (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + mệnh đề wh-.
Điểm ngữ pháp: It was established whether …
mcq.key: The decision to build the bridge was taken before it was ___ whether it was actually needed.|established

mcq.question: It has not yet been ___ who was responsible for the error.
mcq.full: It has not yet been explained who was responsible for the error.
mcq.vi: Vẫn chưa được giải thích ai chịu trách nhiệm cho lỗi này.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + wh-clause.
It + bị động (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + mệnh đề wh-.
Điểm ngữ pháp: explain + mệnh đề wh- (claim không dùng với wh-).
mcq.key: It has not yet been ___ who was responsible for the error.|explained

mcq.question: It has been ___ how spiders are able to travel across the sea.
mcq.full: It has been discovered how spiders are able to travel across the sea.
mcq.vi: Người ta đã phát hiện cách loài nhện có thể vượt biển.
mcq.expl:
It + passive (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + wh-clause.
It + bị động (revealed / explained / discovered / established) + mệnh đề wh-.
Điểm ngữ pháp: discover + mệnh đề wh- (say không dùng với how).
mcq.key: It has been ___ how spiders are able to travel across the sea.|discovered

mcq.question: It is thought (that) there are too many obstacles to peace. → There are thought ___ too many obstacles to peace.
mcq.full: It is thought (that) there are too many obstacles to peace. → There are thought to be too many obstacles to peace.
mcq.vi: Người ta cho rằng có quá nhiều trở ngại cho hòa bình. → Được cho là có quá nhiều trở ngại cho hòa bình.
mcq.expl:
It is thought that there are … → There are thought to be …
It is thought that there are … → There are thought to be …
Điểm ngữ pháp: there + bị động + to be.
mcq.key: It is thought (that) there are too many obstacles to peace. → There are thought ___ too many obstacles to peace.|to be

mcq.question: ___ are thought to be too many obstacles to peace.
mcq.full: There are thought to be too many obstacles to peace.
mcq.vi: Được cho là có quá nhiều trở ngại cho hòa bình.
mcq.expl:
It is thought that there are … → There are thought to be …
It is thought that there are … → There are thought to be …
Điểm ngữ pháp: there + be thought to be.
mcq.key: ___ are thought to be too many obstacles to peace.|There
